articles.title: Israeli strike kills Palestinian man, wounds two others in Gaza
articles.summary: A Palestinian man has been killed and two others wounded after Israeli forces carried out a drone strike on the al-Mawasi area of Khan Younis in southern Gaza, Al Jazeera reported, citing sources at the Nasser Medical Complex.

articles.title: Arab League condemns deadly Israeli strike on Gaza’s Nasser Hospital
articles.summary: Israel’s strike on Nasser Hospital in Khan Younis killed at least six Palestinians, among them a surgeon, and wounded dozens on Wednesday. The Arab League denounced the strike as a “serious escalation”. It warned that Israel’s aid restrictions and repeated breaches of the “ceasefire” could “plunge the Strip into a cycle of sustained violence”.
